findingDetails.title: Canonical switch pointer lands on a missing anchor
findingDetails.scopeProof: injection-contract.md, coverage-rationale.md and README.md are declared reviewScopeFiles, and the broken edge is doc-to-doc inside the target.
findingDetails.case: A maintainer opens coverage-rationale.md, follows the README.md#kill-switch-index link to check a switch name, and lands at the top of the README instead of the switch table.
findingDetails.description: Two contract docs link to README.md#kill-switch-index, but the rewritten README defines no heading or anchor by that id.

findingDetails.title: Browsable tree omits the session-handover history engine
findingDetails.scopeProof: The root README and the session-handover README are declared reviewScopeFiles, and the omitted folder holds 27 tracked files.
findingDetails.case: A maintainer follows the browsable tree to change the history lookup, finds no history folder entry, and edits bin/history-lookup.mjs instead of the engine.
findingDetails.description: The directory tree lists bin/history-lookup.mjs but omits the history folder it belongs to.

findingDetails.title: Phase-4 README count no longer reproduces from its own command
findingDetails.scopeProof: SC-001, the phase summary and the root README are declared reviewScopeFiles, and the observed counts come from the target tree.
findingDetails.case: A reviewer reruns SC-001 on the merged tree, sees 105, and cannot tell whether the phase regressed or the counting basis changed.
findingDetails.description: SC-001 states the find command prints 104; it prints 105 because the folder-root README is included, while 104 tracked concern READMEs remain.

results.summary: README structure, runtime-table shape and the concern-key to folder map hold on every sampled surface; SC-001's counting command prints 105 against the stated 104, so this README surface is partial pending R4-P2-003. Iteration 3 behavioral evidence is unaffected.

noveltyJustification: First maintainability pass: three new P2 documentation findings, none refines an existing id. The deferred count-drift item SL-013 is resolved here as R4-P2-003 rather than left deferred.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: A multi-document hook library surface with cross-document references; not trivial and not a single-file pass.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The strategy next focus named the README family, the concern-key divergence, the session-handover split and the deferred count; four READMEs sample the real-core family and the split page.
omittedHighRiskTargets: the remaining concern and per-runtime READMEs
runtime adapter code, exhausted by the correctness and security passes

headings are numbered 1 OVERVIEW to 8 RELATED; the table sits under OVERVIEW with no anchor

searchLedger.rationale: Both canonical pointers land at the page top, not at the switch table.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The browsable tree block no longer matches the session-handover folder after the split.

searchActions.result: bin/history-lookup.mjs listed, no history folder entry
27 tracked files across lib, tests, dist and a README

searchLedger.rationale: The engine is real code in the hub, not a filtered link-only folder.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The 104 and 105 totals differ by counting basis and snapshot, not by a README regression.

spec.md:184 states 104; implementation-summary.md:59 states 104; line 146 records post-merge pass=105
